FAQ

Questions, answered.

Everything customers usually ask before ordering their first bottle.

How long does the fragrance actually last?

NOIR ESSENCE is extrait de parfum at 22% oil concentration. On skin it lasts 10–12+ hours; on fabric, often into the next day. Two to three sprays are enough — more is not better with extrait strength.

Is delivery available outside Dhaka?

Yes — we deliver all over Bangladesh in 2–3 working days. Delivery is free inside Dhaka; outside Dhaka a ৳120 courier charge applies. Cash on delivery is available everywhere.

Can I exchange a perfume after opening it?

Yes. If the scent isn't right for you, you can exchange it for another fragrance in the collection within 7 days of delivery — even after opening, as long as the bottle is mostly full.

Are the ingredients natural or synthetic?

We use natural hero ingredients — real Cambodian oud, Taif rose absolute and vanilla bourbon — supported by safe modern aroma molecules for projection and longevity. No bottle is 100% synthetic.

How do I order?

Add your fragrance to the bag and tap "Checkout on WhatsApp", or use the order form below — it opens WhatsApp with your order already written. Confirm your name, phone and address there, and pay cash when your bottle arrives.

Is this an original brand or a copy of a designer perfume?

NOIR ESSENCE is an original house. Our blends are created by our own perfumer in Dhaka and are not copies or "inspired versions" of any designer fragrance.
